title: Effect of a transducer action
statement: Let $x$ be a binary string, let $q,q'$ be control states of the dual transducer, let $p$ be an input-head position, let $w$ be an output word, let $d\in\{-1,0,1\}$, and let $o$ be an optional output bit. Applying the action that moves the input head by $d$, enters $q'$, and emits $o$ to the configuration with state $q$, position $p$, and output $w$ gives the configuration with state $q'$, head position moved by $d$ with boundary clamping, and output $w$ followed by $o$ if present.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a valid input-head position for $x$
replaced:
For every input $x$, applying the zero-work-tape action that moves the input head by
$d$, enters $q'$, and optionally emits $o$ to the configuration with state $q$, head
position $p$, and output $w$ yields the configuration with state $q'$, head position
$p$ moved by $d$ (clamped at the boundary blanks), and output $w$ followed by $o$.
